name: cortex_promote_memory
description: Promote a memory to a higher layer: working to episodic, or episodic to semantic. Creates a new memory at the target level, tracking lineage via merged_from. Optionally provide revised content for the promoted memory.

memory_id.description: ID of the memory to promote

revised_content.description: Optional revised content for the promoted memory. If omitted, the original content is used.

revised_title.description: Optional revised title for the promoted memory. If omitted, the original title is used.

tags.description: Optional tags to add or replace on the promoted memory
